heroHeadline: Russian Strikes Kill at Least 9 and Cut Power to Over 500,000 as Energy Truce Collapses
heroSubtitle: An overnight missile and drone assault hit Kyiv, Kharkiv and Lutsk energy sites. Zelensky says allies gave no warning; Ukraine has resumed refinery strikes inside Russia.
footerNote: Data sourced from official government reports, UN monitoring missions, major international outlets, and institutional analyses. Historical data draws on peer-reviewed scholarship. Casualty figures are contested; ranges reflect scholarly and official estimates.
